title: Bow GUN
description: This is a Resource Pack I made in blockbench that turns Bows into GUN.
body:
Wanted to Have Guns Without Mods? I got you. My Friend Made a Gun model and I turned it into a resource Pack! I Actually Wanted it To Be For 1.21.11 but Its for 1.21 idk why.![The Gun Model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/141b07260df2f9bcabd89f68f71584c2c561dd1e.gif)

The Blockbench File is this so If you wanted it to be Custom of your Own, you can retexture it!
[Download Here!](https://blckbn.ch/Aq6Y0H)
